Meeting Time & Place

Practice schedules are set per program, not club-wide. Each program's page lists its current tryout process and practice day/time under "How to Participate." Most practices run weekly during that program's season, either at Mission San Jose High School or online.

Mailing List

Join the MSJ Academic Challenge Discord server and use the #competition-select channel to sign up for events and join the mailing lists for each competition you're interested in.

AC

Academic Challenge
A student-run club at Mission San Jose High School that competes in Science Olympiad, Science Bowl, Quiz Bowl, Ocean Science Bowl, and History Bowl at the regional, state, and national levels.
